dedupe_keys.name: servizisct regione vda it transport datasets

description: The Autonomous Region of Aosta Valley publishes transport layers in its regional cartographic system. The existing group retains seven original entries for roads, landscape-plan road variants, railway lines and stations, cycling infrastructure and the decommissioned ENI pipeline, plus two previously added PTP members for high walking routes and interchange nodes. Ten further native PTP members describe paths in equipped urban green areas, hiking-network support facilities and stage posts, the Cogne–Pila train, vehicle-flow regulation points, historic routes and hiking tours, PMIR 6 high-route guidelines and symbols, and planned stations. They share the PTP title series, regional publisher and CTRN 1:10,000 cartographic lineage. Symbols, route representations and earlier high-route layers may overlap; no disjoint asset total is claimed. Coverage is Aosta Valley. The added metadata is dated December 2010 and names GeoJSON access, with some WMS routes. It states public access and links a provider reuse document whose precise licence terms were not read; file-use costs remain unknown. Planned stations remain plans, and the source does not establish present operation, connectivity, capacity or a specific simulation application. Earlier components and access routes are retained. Related regional road and rail resources describe additional plan layers. No feature, map or linked document body was obtained.
